resources.name: BCDI reconstruction dataset

access.notes: Contains BCDI diffraction patterns, reconstructions, dislocation node positions, Burgers vector (b = a0/2[110]), elastic constants (Poisson's ratio nu=0.28), lattice parameter a0, experimental epsilon_111 strain maps at multiple hydrogen charging times, and analysis scripts.

resources.notes: This is the sole external input required. The dataset provides all necessary reference quantities and strain fields.
